newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Moody's assigns Stockholm City EMTNs Aa3 rating.
newsitem.headline: Moody's assigns Stockholm City EMTNs Aa3 rating.

text.p: U.S. ratings agency Moody's said on Thursday it assigned the ratings of Aa3 longterm and Prime-1 shortterm to the City of Stockholm's foreign currency and domestic currency Euro Medium Term Notes (EMTN).

"The ratings reflect the improved financial position of Stockholm, mirroring also the negative effects on the city's economy of high social expenditure and limited scope for tax increases," Moody's said in a statement.
The agency said about $1 billion of debt securities was affected.
Moody's said Stockholm has been helped by a revised revenue-equalization system that was implemented in January 1996.
"The old system heavily disfavoured larger urban areas while the new system has led to an increase in the amount of transfers received by Stockholm," the statement said.
"Debt service levels, although still high, are stable."
